01-hero.png: FramedBlocks Fabric. Over 200 framed shapes that take on the look of any block. For Fabric, Minecraft 1.21.1. Unofficial port of FramedBlocks by XFactHD. In the background, a cottage built from framed blocks.
02-camo.png: Any block, any shape. A new framed block is an empty wooden frame. Two pictures of the same eight framed shapes, among them a slope, stairs and a corner slope: before, empty wooden frames; after, each one has a different camo, such as oak planks, stone bricks, copper, cherry planks and sandstone. Right-click with a block: the framed block takes the look of the block in your hand. Fluids work too. Take it off: the Framed Hammer removes the camo again. Not accepted as camo: blocks with block entities and untagged non-solid blocks.
03-shapes.png: Over 230 framed shapes. 269 blocks in the registry. 232 framed shapes with an item. 2 Framing Saws to switch between shapes. A picture of 48 different framed shapes on pedestals, all with the same smooth quartz camo. Shapes include cubes, slabs, panels, slopes, stairs, corner and prism pieces, pillars, slope edges, slope panel and slab corners, pyramids, checkered and layered variants, collapsible blocks and double blocks.
04-double.png: Two camos in one block. Double blocks hold two framed parts in one block space, and each part takes its own camo. A picture of ten double blocks, each with two different camos. Up close: the roof of a cottage, built from framed slopes and inner and outer corner slopes with wood plank camos.
05-light-fluids.png: Light and fluids. A picture of framed lamp heads along a path at night: heads with a glowstone, shroomlight or sea lantern camo give off light, and glowstone dust makes the other heads glow too. A picture of framed slabs, slopes, stairs and other shapes with fluid camos: water in the back row, lava in the middle row, oak planks in the front row for comparison.
06-functional.png: Framed blocks that work. A picture of framed functional blocks with wood and stone camos: a sign with text, an item frame holding a Framed Hammer, a door, a button, a wall torch, a lever, a chest, a flower pot with a poppy, a pressure plate, two rail slopes, a fence gate and three lanterns. Doors, iron doors, signs, hanging signs, item frames, lanterns, torches, levers, flower pots and bars, each shown with its item. Also: trapdoors, gates, fences, walls, ladders, buttons, pressure plates, bookshelves, chests, hoppers, secret storage, tanks, panes, a lightning rod, a target block, a bouncy cube, a redstone block, rails and rail slopes.
07-tools.png: Tools and upgrades. Each shown with its item. Framed Hammer: removes the camo and toggles options such as waterlogging. Framed Wrench: rotates blocks and switches some shape variants. Framed Screwdriver: rotates the camo texture. Framed Key: locks the state of a block. Framed Blueprint: copies a framed block with its camo; the materials must be in your inventory. Upgrades, each shown with its item: glowstone dust, the block gives off light. Framed Reinforcement: blast resistance of obsidian, and the camo no longer burns; a pickaxe that can mine obsidian removes it. Phantom Paste: the block becomes intangible (server config option).
08-saw.png: Switch shapes with the Framing Saw. A picture of the Framing Saw screen: framed cubes in the input slot, the slope recipe selected in the searchable recipe list, framed slopes in the output slot. Framing Saw: turns framed blocks into other framed shapes, by material value. Powered Framing Saw: works without energy by default. With the optional Team Reborn Energy installed, other mods can feed energy into the Powered Framing Saw from every side except the top. It never outputs energy. The server config option poweredSawRequiresEnergy, false by default, makes energy required.
09-compat.png: Optional integrations. Each one is only active when the other mod is installed: JEI, REI, EMI, Jade, Diagonal Blocks, Amendments, Searchables, Additional Placements, AtlasViewer and Team Reborn Energy. JEI, REI, EMI and Jade load their plugin in the automated client test. The others are not tested in game yet. Removed in this port: Create, Applied Energistics 2 and Building Gadgets, because no Fabric builds of them exist for Minecraft 1.21.1.
10-install.png: Install in three steps. 1, Fabric: install Fabric Loader 0.19 or newer for Minecraft 1.21.1, and Fabric API. 2, Mods folder: put the mod into the mods folder of the game, and of the server for multiplayer. 3, Play: start the game. Requirements: Java 21. Needed on both the client and the server. Forge Config API Port is bundled. Not compatible with NeoForge worlds: the mod id is framedblocks_fabric, so worlds and items from the NeoForge version do not carry over.
